note: One register per claim of `[[representation.alias_window]]`. A window's bounds are 1 January of its first source edition's year to 31 December of its last. OWNED: value owns OLD through its 2018 state, and NEW's 2019 and 2020 states (two states, since 2020's data length differs) cover the 2019-2020 window across a state boundary, so the window applies, attributed to its entry, and adds no state; later's OLD in 2021 is another owner outside the window and does not block it. ALIASED: income owns first only through the alias its 2020 `[[representation.parallel]]` forms (the replaced tests' owned alias), and its 2021 First state covers the 2021 window, which first gains beside its source-derived 2020 window. SEARCHED: OLD's only owner is the `[[enrichment.alias]]` of the same build, and ownership is checked on the variables before any annotation, so the window is unowned and the search alias stays without windows. GAP: the spring-term 2019 state and the 2020 state leave July to December 2019 uncovered inside the 2019-2020 window. CONTESTED: rival delivers OLD in 2019, another supported owner in the window, so the entry evaluates as applicable but its window is refused, and the register publishes only its state spellings (the whole-scope check of the replaced test_source_scope_partitions.py test). COMPETE: two windows assign X to first (2018-2019) and second (2019-2020); the replaced test's March-April and April-May month windows become these annual editions, so only the 2019 overlap is withheld, once per entry, and each keeps its own year. PARALLEL: a search alias on first, whose 2020 window comes from `[[representation.parallel]]`, keeps that window, and a source-derived window has no provenance. STALE names a variable slug the register does not compile; TWICE's 2019 edition has two NEW members of the variable.
fails_if: `apply_alias_cases` (source_annotations.py) checks ownership on the annotated variables instead of the originals (SEARCHED's window applies); drops the state or alias ownership branch, the coverage check or the other-owner check (SEARCHED, ALIASED, GAP or CONTESTED changes); refuses CONTESTED's entry when its targets are evaluated instead of when its window is applied (its case stops being applicable), or answers the competing owner by withholding a column instead of the window (value or rival loses its OLD spelling); requires one state to cover a whole window, checks only a window's ends, or counts another owner outside the window (OWNED's or GAP's outcome changes); withholds a competing window whole instead of its overlap (COMPETE loses 2018 or 2020); replaces an existing alias on a search alias instead of keeping it (PARALLEL's first loses its 2020 window); writes a curated window without its entry's provenance, or a state for it; or `compile_alias_windows` (curation_compile.py) stops refusing an unresolved FQID (STALE) or an edition with two targets (TWICE), or derives the bounds from anything but the source edition years
